name: Vigil
source:
An angel with a lot (a lot) to say, but has no one that particularly wants to listen to him. He seeks to prove himself by constantly training. He is fastidious and fussy to the extent that even Rune cannot match his... zealousness. Perhaps he always has a lot to say because he is afraid of the moments it is all too quiet? More to be revealed...

HOBBIES:
Knitting, baking, cooking, training, studying architecture, visiting famous sites in the human world, museum hopping.

LIKES:
Cleaning, magazines from the human world (interior decor, housekeeping)

DISLIKES:
Slobs, laziness, being bored, being idle, making mistakes, losing, getting called out for whining
